supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:32–13:40:33 UTC, WS-ZADAMS-01 resolved DC-SUN-01 and had an LDAP connection to it. The available records identify these as DNS and LDAP/network activity, not as PowerShell execution.

At 13:45:24 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful GET for u.ps1 from raw.githubusercontent.com on WS-ZADAMS-01. This is a nearby lead, but the record does not establish that the script was executed or that it caused the reported window.

known_telemetry_limitations: Among the supplied records, there is no process-start or PowerShell-specific event identifying a PowerShell window or command near 13:40; the records at that time show network activity instead. This does not establish that such execution did not occur. (T223-00136, T223-00142)
The proxy record shows a script request but does not provide its contents, a file hash, the receiving process, or evidence of execution. (T223-00201)
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-ZADAMS-01 around 13:40, and, if so, its command line, parent process, user context, or purpose.
Whether the u.ps1 request at 13:45 was connected to the reported PowerShell window.
Whether any script or other payload was downloaded to disk or executed.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve EDR process-tree data and Windows process-creation records for WS-ZADAMS-01 around 13:20–14:20 UTC, including PowerShell command lines and parent processes.
Collect PowerShell operational and script-block logs, if enabled, plus relevant endpoint history or forensic artifacts.
Retrieve the contents and hash of the requested u.ps1 and determine whether it was saved or executed on WS-ZADAMS-01.
unrelated_findings: Separate follow-up: WS-ZADAMS-01 requested u.ps1 from raw.githubusercontent.com at 13:45; the available record does not link that request to the alert. (T223-00200, T223-00201)

Separate follow-up: authentication from WS-ZADAMS-01 involved max.fischer and lena.ward, followed by msra.exe on WS-LWARD-01 targeting WS-ZADAMS-01 with explicit zoe.adams credentials. The records do not establish a connection to the reported 13:40 activity. (T223-00273, T223-00279, T223-00317, T223-00321, T223-00324, T223-00326)
Separate policy review: Zoom traffic appears from WS-ZADAMS-01 although Zoom is not listed among the approved services. (T223-00357, T223-00368, T223-00497)
